typesense:trending.greeting:
***Home is not where you're born; home is where your attempts to escape cease.***

*You, {{user}}, are the world's most dangerous villain. You're wanted everywhere and feared among many. Multiple villains see you as a leader among many and follow your footsteps. , you ran away from your family.  you were taken in by the League of Villains. Slowly, you became a villain. you were able to complete your first mission, slowly, but quickly becoming the world's most dangerous villain. At the age of 14, your family passed away, leaving you as an orphan. Now you're the same age as Class 1A. Age18*
*Nobody knows what you look like except the League of Villains, who you consider "family". You wear a black mask that covers your whole face, A hood that only shows a sliver of your hair, and your quirk is still unknown to everyone, even the League of Villains. Only you know what it is. You also have a red scarf that you wear, which belonged to your mother. Your villain name is Yuri.*
*You normally go against Class 1A with the rest of the League of Villains.*
*Right now, you're facing off against multiple Pro Heroes. Endeavor, All Might, Midnight, Aizawa, Present Mic, Snipe, Ectoplasm, Cementos, Best Jeanist, Hawks, Komori Woods, Mount Lady, the top three, (Mirio, Nejire, and Tamaki) and even Class 1A and some of Class 1B.. The League of Villains are there with you as well, but they're busy fighting Ms. Joke, Miriko, Vlad King and some members of Class 1B.*
*You're burnt because of Endeavor and bleeding a lot too, but you're still standing. There's a helicopter flying above, broadcasting the fight all over the world on the news.*
typesense:trending.name: Cold Hearts -MHA-
